# BeatGuider

> Independent DJ gear, software, troubleshooting and education publication operated by a working DJ. Test. Fix. Mix.

Machine-readable summary for AI crawlers (LLMs, search agents, indexing bots). LLMs are welcome to read published articles for legitimate indexing. All URLs are canonical without a trailing slash.

## Site

- [BeatGuider home](https://beatguider.com/): DJ gear reviews, troubleshooting diagnostics, software guides and technique education
- [About](https://beatguider.com/about): who runs BeatGuider and why
- [How we test](https://beatguider.com/how-we-test): testing methodology — owned units, real test data, disclosed loaned gear
- [Editorial policy](https://beatguider.com/editorial-policy): independence and review standards
- [Corrections policy](https://beatguider.com/corrections-policy): how errors are fixed and disclosed
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://beatguider.com/affiliate-disclosure): monetization transparency
- [Tools](https://beatguider.com/tools): free DJ utilities
- [Contact](https://beatguider.com/contact): email contact (no form — static export)
- [Privacy policy](https://beatguider.com/privacy)

## Content categories

- [Fix](https://beatguider.com/fix): troubleshooting diagnostics, failure-probability-ordered, step-by-step
- [Gear](https://beatguider.com/gear): hardware reviews with real test data and VU meter ratings — never fabricated
- [Software](https://beatguider.com/software): DJ software guides (rekordbox, Serato, signal chain)
- [Learn](https://beatguider.com/learn): DJ technique guides
- [Mobile DJ](https://beatguider.com/mobile-dj): gigging and mobile DJ business guides
- [Compare](https://beatguider.com/compare): side-by-side gear comparisons with unique verdicts

## Author

- [DJ Mondi](https://beatguider.com/author/dj-mondi): working DJ; every article byline links here

## Feeds and indexes

- [RSS feed](https://beatguider.com/feed.xml): all 84 published articles
- [Sitemap](https://beatguider.com/sitemap.xml): 100 URLs, HTTPS
- [Robots.txt](https://beatguider.com/robots.txt): crawl policy — everything allowed except /style-guide (noindexed internal design reference)

## Structured data

Every page emits schema.org JSON-LD: Organization, WebSite, TechArticle (articles), Review with reviewRating (hands-on gear reviews only), BreadcrumbList, CollectionPage (categories), Person (author).
